text: Perspective warp of the 4-point quad to a perfect rectangle
description: Compute homography from the 4 selected corners and rectify the image to a straight rectangle (aspect ratio from calibrated real size). Store original + rectified image.

status.comment: bridge/warp.ts: homography + bilinear sampling on sharp raw buffer, output aspect from real cm size. Verified with a synthetic 5°-rotated painting: rectified cleanly, corner markers in place.
